items.name: set_issue_status
items.summary: Set the status of an issue (and optionally its triage note)

items.name: add_note
items.summary: Append a line to the triage note of an issue

items.name: set_alert_threshold
items.summary: Change an alert threshold (error_rate_pct, startup_p95_s, stream_saturation_pct, disk_pct)

items.name: retry_source
items.summary: Retry a failing stream source now: close its circuit breaker instead of waiting for the backoff

items.name: warm_cache
items.summary: Resolve the sources of an episode in the background so its next play starts from the cache

items.name: requeue_av1
items.summary: Put a copy whose AV1 encode was abandoned back in the encode queue

items.name: pause_source
items.summary: Pause a stream source for 5 to 1440 minutes (its queries are skipped, the other sources answer)

items.name: purge_cache
items.summary: Purge a cache scope (episode_sources or indexer_results); it cannot be undone, it refills on demand

items.name: limit_concurrent_streams
items.summary: Cap the concurrent playback sessions (0 lifts the cap); sessions already open keep playing

items.name: schedule_maintenance
items.summary: Schedule a maintenance window (at most 24 h, within 30 days): announced on the public status page, watch notifications muted while it runs
